action_inputs.description: CloudBolt Environment to deploy into. Lists the Azure-backed environments the ordering group may use (group.get_available_environments()). Its resource handler supplies the subscription and tenant written to the workspace as ARM_SUBSCRIPTION_ID / ARM_TENANT_ID, and it drives the form's resource group, subnet, image and size dropdowns through the form-options inbound webhook. The handler is never exposed.
action_inputs.label: Environment
action_inputs.name: env_id

action_inputs.description: JSON object of Terraform template variable name/value pairs, funneled from the order form's Dynamic Panel (field names match the template's variables, and the panel includes vm_name -- e.g. {"vm_name": "tfc-demo-vm-01", "vm_size": "Standard_B2s", "location": "eastus"}). Supplied by the custom form; leave blank to fall back to the template defaults (an empty payload parses to {}). Blank/None values are dropped so a left-blank field stays unset rather than being written as an empty string.
action_inputs.label: Template Variables (JSON)
action_inputs.name: parameters

action_inputs.description: VCS branch the workspace tracks. Pinned per blueprint.
action_inputs.label: TFC VCS Branch
action_inputs.name: tfc_branch

action_inputs.description: Terraform Cloud/Enterprise connection to provision through (a 'tf-cloud'-labeled ConnectionInfo global_id, HCP Terraform TEAM token in the password field). Pinned per blueprint via parameter_defaults on the build item -- not selected on the order form.
action_inputs.label: TF Cloud Connection
action_inputs.name: tfc_connection_info

action_inputs.description: HCP Terraform organization the deployment's workspace is created in. Pinned per blueprint via parameter_defaults.
action_inputs.label: TFC Organization
action_inputs.name: tfc_organization

action_inputs.description: HCP Terraform project that holds the deployment's workspace (a project-scoped variable set supplies the cloud credentials). Pinned per blueprint via parameter_defaults.
action_inputs.label: TFC Project
action_inputs.name: tfc_project

action_inputs.description: VCS repo (org/name) holding the parameterized Terraform configuration the workspace tracks. Pinned per blueprint via parameter_defaults.
action_inputs.label: TFC VCS Repo
action_inputs.name: tfc_repo_identifier

action_inputs.description: Terraform working directory within the VCS repo (empty for the repo root). Pinned per blueprint.
action_inputs.label: TFC Working Directory
action_inputs.name: tfc_working_directory

description: Provisions a VM through HCP Terraform into a chosen CloudBolt environment's Azure subscription, in a dedicated workspace with a plan-approval pause before apply.
name: HCP Terraform VM
